name: Notification
label: Notification

fields.label: Document type
fields.description: For an event from code: empty - whatever document the event is about

fields.label: Event
fields.options:
after_insert
after_save
on_transition
value_change
days_before
days_after
code

fields.label: Code event
fields.description: An event the framework or an app raises from code, e.g. a task assigned

fields.label: Date field
fields.description: Date/Datetime field of the document the reminder is counted from, e.g. contract_end

fields.label: Days
fields.description: How many days before/after the date; 0: on the day itself. Sent once a day at 08:00

fields.label: Every year
fields.description: Match only day and month - birthdays, work anniversaries

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Python expression on doc and user, e.g. doc.status == 'Open'. Empty: always

fields.label: Also notify who did it
fields.description: By default the user whose action triggered the notification is not notified

fields.label: Subject
fields.description: Jinja: {{ doc.field }}, {{ doctype }}, {{ event }}, {{ actor }} (who did it), {{ url }}; on a workflow transition also {{ action }}, {{ from_state }}, {{ to_state }}, {{ comment }}

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Jinja, same variables as the subject

fields.label: Standard
fields.description: Ships with the app as JSON files - edits are saved to the app

fields.label: Changed on this site
fields.description: A standard notification edited here: updates of the app no longer overwrite it. Reset to standard to follow the app again

description: When something happens to a document, who is told, what and through which channels
